description_en: You can invoke GetVoicemailRecording to obtain the voicemail recording of a specified call under a specified instance. The recording is single-track and in WAV format
description_zh: 调用GetVoicemailRecording获取指定实例下指定通话的语音信箱留言的录音，录音为单轨录音，格式为WAV
kebab_example: aliyun ccc get-voicemail-recording --instance-id ccc-test --contact-id job-125152394144120000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVoicemailRecording

parameters.help_en: Call ID. Ensure that this call ID has a voicemail message; otherwise, the return result will contain no data
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID，请确保该通话ID存在语音信箱留言，否则返回结果将没有数据
parameters.name: contact_id
